prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins the 2016 US presidential election (8 November 2016), per the individual panel astrologer singled out in this item. That astrologer — who, against a 17-candidate field, had already correctly picked Trump as the Republican nominee — follows the same reading through to the general election and picks Trump over Hillary Clinton, against the polls. Timing: decided on election day, 8 November 2016.
basis:
This card bears no tradition/system field; decided by western election-astrology genre conventions, at the level of the individual forecaster the item isolates.

The consensus/polling pull toward Clinton belongs to the separate panel item (WP-004) and is not merged into this individual's call (object-attribution check: the prediction's bearer is this one astrologer, not the panel). No chart data beyond the card is fabricated. R80-REV1: binary winner only, no magnitude claim, not applicable.
